# CreditDecide

> CreditDecide is an AI-native underwriting and credit decisioning operating system for modern lenders and fintechs. Lenders build underwriting policies visually (no code), collect borrower applications through white-label intake forms with market-specific KYC, connect live credit bureau and open banking data (or upload documents), normalize financial and credit data into canonical profiles, generate structured risk signals with full evidence lineage, apply lender policy, and return an explainable APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE decision. Dedicated configurations for the United Kingdom, United States, Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya and Ghana, plus a flexible "Others" option for any country.
